bibl.title: Invocations of the Blood of Christ in Greek Magical Amulets.
bibl.seg: Elena Chepel, Invocations of the Blood of Christ in Greek Magical Amulets.
Scrinium. Journal of Patrology and Critical Hagiography 13 (2017) pp. 53-71.
